written_before: any examination of the October 2026 test month
question: Can $20 CAD become >= $30 CAD NET (after FX, spread, slippage and taker fees) within 10 minutes (E10) and within 20 minutes (E20)? Two independent tests.

research_data.source: Binance public bulk 1-minute klines, every USDT spot pair in exchangeInfo including delisted (status BREAK), excluding stablecoins/pegged/wrapped/leveraged/tokenized-equity bases
research_data.missing_minutes: any missing minute inside a forward window -> sample dropped (never a hit or a miss)
research_data.label_caveat: candle highs include buyer-initiated prints at the ask; research touch labels are therefore slightly optimistic for a seller. Live verification uses seller-initiated trades only.

target.touch: highest price in (t, t+h] >= entry x M
target.finish: price at t+h >= entry x M
target.M_derivation: 30/20 with FX cost 0.5% per side (CAD<->USDT), Binance taker fee 0.10% per side, half-spread 0.10% and slippage 0.05% per side
target.live: M is recomputed per candidate from the live order book, the live CAD/USDT rate and the venue fee

model.type: L2 logistic regression (RareEventLogit), pooled over thresholds M in {1.02,1.03,1.05,1.075,1.1,1.15,1.2,1.3,1.5,2.0}, separate models for touch and finish and for h=10 and h=20
inputs: ln standardized distance ln(ln M/(sigma60*sqrt h))
model.fitting: case-control sampling (all positives, up to 30 negatives per positive, negatives re-weighted) so probabilities stay calibrated
model.regularization_choice: C in {0.01, 0.1, 1}: fit on 2026-08, choose by log loss on 2026-09; then refit on 2026-08..09 for the test
model.live_model: refit with the chosen C on 2026-08..10 after the test (the tested model's results are what is reported)
model.price_intervals: empirical quantiles of ln(P_t+h/P_t)/(sigma60*sqrt h) from training months; median = best estimate

baselines: always-NO (reported only; trivially 'accurate' for rare events)
primary_metrics: observed vs expected events with exact Poisson CI
calibration table by predicted-probability bin with Wilson CIs
top-1 hit rate per decision time vs baselines
overlap: E10 decisions every 10 min with 10-min horizon and E20 every 20 min with 20-min horizon: no overlap within a coin. Events cluster across coins at the same time; universe-level results are reported per decision time.
qualification_rule_live: QUALIFIES only if (1) calibrated P(touch the net $30 target within h) >= 0.50 AND (2) the venue supports trade-level verification AND (3) the live book fills the $20 CAD entry completely with entry slippage <= 1.0% and spread <= 1.0% AND (4) 24h quote volume >= $100,000 AND (5) data are fresh (last 1-min candle <= 3 min old, CAD rate <= 24 h old). Otherwise the record says: NO QUALIFYING OPPORTUNITY FOUND. The best candidate is still recorded with its probability for calibration.
live_verification: TOUCHED only if a seller-initiated trade (taker sold, i.e. executable for a seller) printed at >= the target touch price inside (origin, expiry]. NOT TOUCHED if every 1-minute candle high in the window is below the target (exact: highs include all trades). FINISHED ABOVE if the last seller-initiated trade at or before expiry is >= target. Missing data -> UNVERIFIABLE, never counted as a win.
not_claimed: No claim that $20 can reliably become $30. No real trades.
